environment.description: The MSK cluster is configured with PrivateLink interface endpoints only (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Public access is disabled at the MSK cluster level. The VPC endpoint policy restricts kafka:CreateTopic and kafka-cluster:WriteData to principals matching condition aws:PrincipalOrgID=o-abc123def4. The producer service (the only authorized writer) runs in a separate VPC (10.1.0.0/16) peered via TransitGateway with route table entries scoped to the MSK broker ENI CIDR (10.0.4.0/28). Security groups on the MSK broker ENIs restrict inbound TCP/9094 to sg-0fedcba9876543210 (the producer service's security group). No NAT gateway or internet gateway is attached to either VPC. DNS resolution for the bootstrap servers resolves only within the VPC via Route53 private hosted zone associated exclusively with the two peered VPCs.

config.vpc_internet_access: no IGW, no NAT, no public subnets
config.dns_resolution: Route53 private hosted zone, not resolvable outside VPC
